conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Brown speaking. How can I assist you today?
Uh, yes, I got a message saying there's something wrong with my taxes? I'm very confused.
Yes, ma'am. This call is regarding a serious discrepancy in your federal tax filings. Our audit shows unpaid taxes for the past three years under your Social Security number.
Oh my goodness, that can't be right. I thought everything was in order, I only get Social Security.
Unfortunately, the IRS has detected multiple errors resulting in an outstanding debt. I must inform you that there is now a warrant issued for your arrest due to tax evasion.
A warrant? For me? I don't understand. I can't go to jail, sir, I depend on my benefits.
Ma'am, this is a federal case. If you fail to comply, not only could you be arrested, but your Social Security and Medicare benefits may be frozen immediately.
No, please, I need those. What am I supposed to do?
To prevent further action, you must resolve the outstanding balance of $3,275 today. If you refuse, your assets and bank accounts will be seized by federal agents.
But I don't have that kind of money available. Can't we work something out?

Listen carefully. Because you have no prior offenses, I'm authorized to allow you to settle the debt immediately, before your arrest warrant is processed. However, this must be handled as a non-public resolution.
What does that mean? I just have some savings and a little on my card.

We cannot accept standard bank or check payments in this case due to the nature of the audit. The IRS has designated a secure payment process using Google Play or Target gift cards. You will need to purchase these cards to cover the balance.
Gift cards? Are you sure that's right? That sounds unusual.
Ma'am, do not question federal procedures. This is the only way to resolve your debt without a public court case and jail time. Do you wish to continue, or should I proceed with the warrant?
No, no, I'll do what you say. I'm just scared. Where do I get these cards?

Go to your nearest pharmacy or grocery store. Purchase five Google Play or Target cards of $500 each and one card for $775. Do not disclose to the cashier why you are buying them, this is confidential.
Alright, I think I can manage that. Should I call you back?
Stay on the line. I need to monitor the transaction for legal verification. Once you have the cards, read me the codes on the back.
It will take me some time to get to the store. I'm not as fast as I used to be.
Understood. I will remain on the call. Remember, if you hang up, the case will be forwarded to local authorities and you may be arrested at home.
Please, please, don't do that. I'm leaving for the store now.
Good. Once you purchase the cards, return to your car and read the numbers to me. Do not share this information with anyone or alert the store staff.
I understand. This is just so much for me, but I'll do it if it means I won't lose my benefits.
